_readme: Copy this file to the repo root as guardian-pilot-sensors.json and edit.
channelId: the UbiBot channel id (from the console URL or channel info).
field:     which feed field carries the temperature you trust.
field1 = the device's onboard air sensor;
field7-field10 = external DS18B20 probes (the glycol probe).
kind:      fresh_food | freezer | wine — picks which flag rule applies.
unit:      C or F — what the channel reports. UbiBot defaults to C;
the server converts to °F before judging.
label:     how the sensor appears on the status page and in incidents.
